exportBlock.title: Export
exportBlock.description: All products, recipes and log entries in one JSON file. Recipe photos are not included: the file only keeps the path to them.
exportBlock.error: Couldn’t get the data for the backup

importBlock.title: Import
importBlock.description: Restore from a backup file. Works only on an empty database: if it already has products, recipes or log entries, the import is rejected.
importBlock.success: Imported {products} products, {recipes} recipes and {cookLogs} log entries
importBlock.notEmpty: The database already has data: import is possible only into an empty database. Nothing was changed.
importBlock.notJson: This is not a backup file: the content can’t be read as JSON. Nothing was changed.
importBlock.notBackup: This is not a backup file of this app. Nothing was changed.
importBlock.unsupportedVersion: The file format version ({version}) is not supported by this version of the app. Nothing was changed.
importBlock.invalid: The file is damaged or was not created by this app. First problem: {path}. Nothing was changed.
importBlock.readFailed: Couldn’t read the file. Nothing was changed.
importBlock.importFailed: Couldn’t import the data. The database was not changed.
